text: {"name":"bt_conn_timer_handler","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Periodically walks a linked list of Bluetooth connection contexts under a save-IRQ critical section, decrements per-link latency counters, services expired connection/HCI events, and computes/stores the next event tick.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v0":"conn","v1":"lock_count_ptr","v3":"irq_was_disabled","v8":"event_window_ticks","v9":"current_tick_minus_3048","v10":"next_event_tick"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"intrusive connection list next pointer"},{"offset":24,"meaning":"kernel event/task handle passed to ke_event_lock"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"next connection event timestamp"},{"offset":72,"meaning":"flag requesting HCI command handling"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"connection state byte; value 2 marks eligible connection"},{"offset":222,"meaning":"per-connection interval word scaled by 2^10"},{"offset":224,"meaning":"initial latency/event countdown"},{"offset":225,"meaning":"remaining latency/event countdown"},{"offset":1224,"meaning":"flag requesting kernel event lock"}]}
